hero.subtitle: We design garden-soft mandaps, stages and entrances in colours chosen around your story, not a catalogue.

approach.title: Every celebration has a colour, a flower and a feeling.
approach.text: We start with how you want your guests to feel, then choose the palette, florals and architecture that make it real. Calm and airy, rich and royal, or playful and bright.

items.title: Mandap & Wedding Stage
items.text: Floral, carved or acrylic mandaps shaped around your rituals and venue.

items.title: Haldi & Mehndi
items.text: Marigold walls, swings, brass urlis and relaxed boho seating.

items.title: Sangeet & Cocktail
items.text: Stage design, dance floor styling and warm, layered lighting.

items.title: Reception & Gala
items.text: Floral walls, couple thrones and statement centerpieces.

items.title: Entrances & Walkways
items.text: Flower tunnels, gates and photo moments from the first step in.

items.title: Parties & Private Events
items.text: Birthdays, anniversaries and corporate evenings with a custom theme.

process.title: From first hello to the last petal
process.text: A clear, calm process, so you can enjoy your own celebration.

steps.title: We listen
steps.text: A quick call or venue visit. We learn your rituals, guest flow, family wishes and budget.

steps.title: We design
steps.text: Moodboard, palette, layout and florals. Larger projects get 3D visuals before you confirm.

steps.title: We build
steps.text: Our crew sets up hours ahead, tests lighting and mists the flowers fresh before guests arrive.

palettes.title: Pick a palette, feel the mood
palettes.text: Tap a colour story to preview its personality. Each one is a starting point we adapt to you.

items.quote: The mandap looked even better than the render. Guests kept asking who our decorator was.
items.name: Ananya & Rohit

items.quote: Haldi and sangeet in one weekend and not a single delay. Calm team, stunning flowers.
items.name: Meera Srivastava

items.quote: Honest advice on what to skip, clear pricing, and the reception stage stole the night.
items.name: Kabir Malhotra

items.a: For peak season (November to February) book 4 to 6 months ahead. For other months 6 to 8 weeks is usually enough.
Yes, across Uttar Pradesh and for destination weddings. Travel and stay are quoted separately.

items.q: Can I see the design first?
items.a: Always. You get a moodboard and layout after the venue visit, and 3D visuals for larger projects.

items.q: Can you work within my budget?
items.a: Yes. Share your budget upfront and we design the best version of your idea inside it.

brief.title: Tell us your story in four quick steps.
brief.text: No long forms. Your answers go to us on WhatsApp so we can reply with ideas.
